nom: COSRX The Blue Peptide Bakuchiol Plump Glow Serum

avis.texte: I started using COSRX about 2 years ago after trying almost every skincare line on the market. $90 moisturizers that smell like my grandma and my skin was breaking out and not improving. A friend of mine had the snail mucin and after trying hers I went out and bought the whole line. Loved it but I needed something heavier since I am in my late 30s. Switched to their peptide serum and cerimide lotion and have been using it religiously for 2 years. When the blue peptide line came out I had to try it and OH MY GOSH I am amazed!!! Immediate glass skin, no irritation or breakouts, plump silky soft skin. I will never ever switch back to american skincare. CORSX has me out here looking 22 and I'm almost 40. Literally 100/10!!!!
Lovely product after two weeks major noticeable difference so smooth and nice plump not sticky will continue
So far I like this. However, be careful if you have sensitive skin. Maybe don't pair it with the moisturizer. By itself, it is nice thiugh
Its good moist and plump when applying to my skin and good combine with the blue peptide cream
Started using about 1 wk ago in combination with a couple other Cosrx products and so far I am loving it, my skin feels hydrated , smoother , very silky and plumper. Will definitely order again!
Really good serum for sensitive skin! Can use day or night Absorbs so nice, feels so plump.
I haven't been using this product for long but it feel nice and moisturizing on my skin.
Face looks better after the first week! Texture has improved, tone looks light and more even. Love this serum!!

So far I really like this product. It is very well spread and moisturizing. The effect lasts longer than other serums I have used. Only one regret is as soon as I received them-I ordered 2-they went on sale!!! I should have waited a few weeks!

Absolutely loving how my skin is looking and feeling after starting this serum! Skin tone looks more even and is so smooth and soft. I pair it with the cream as well and my skin has never looked better at 41.

I was skeptical about this product, but I'm glad I tried it. Definitely a new addition to my skincare routine going forward. It does everything it says it does. I noticed results after the first use. People even noticed my skin was looking better than before, I received several compliments. The packaging and formula are both beautiful. I can even see my lines being less visible. Only thing I would suggest is to send me another bottle as a gift. :sweat_smile:
Absolutely amazing!!! Love how my face feels woth this serum. No need extra steps.

The COSRX The Blue Peptide Bakuchiol Plump Glow Serum is wonderful and gentle, with noticable results after one week of use. Plumping, firming, with visible pore reduction on my nose, chin, and cheeks. Also helps my skin retain moisture, waking up with much more plump, moist skin. It a fantastic addition to my CosRx nightly routine.
Absolutely love the way this applies. It's non-greasy, doesn't feel tacky and absorbs so nicely. I follow up with a moisturizer and it doesn't pill which was a concern of mine. New fav serum

avis.titre: A Gentle Serum with Visible Firming Benefits
avis.texte: I've been using COSRX The Blue Peptide Serum daily on my face and neck for the past month, and the biggest improvement I've noticed is in my neck. The skin on my neck looks firmer, smoother, and more toned, with less visible sagging than before.I've also seen some improvement in the firmness of my face, especially around my jawline. The serum has a lightweight, comfortable texture that absorbs quickly and feels great on my skin.I have sensitive skin and experienced no irritation, redness, or breakouts during use. My before-and-after photos show the noticeable difference, especially in the appearance of my neck. Overall, I'm very happy with the results and will continue using it.

I've been using the COSRX Blue Peptide Bakuchiol Plump Glow Serum for a few weeks, and it has quickly become one of my favorite skincare products. The texture is incredibly smooth, lightweight, and silky, making it easy to apply and layer with the rest of my routine. It absorbs quickly without feeling sticky or greasy, leaving my skin feeling soft, hydrated, and comfortable.What really stands out is the combination of effective ingredients. The bakuchiol provides a gentle alternative to retinol, helping improve skin texture and firmness without irritation. The niacinamide has helped brighten my complexion and even out my skin tone, while hyaluronic acid delivers lasting hydration and gives my skin a healthy, plump appearance. I also love that it contains collagen and adenosine, which contribute to smoother-looking, more youthful skin.After consistent use, my skin looks more radiant, feels firmer, and has a noticeable glow. Fine lines appear softer, and my overall complexion looks healthier and more refreshed. If you're looking for a serum with a smooth texture and a well-rounded blend of proven skincare ingredients, this is definitely worth trying. Highly recommended! :star::star::star::star::star:

This has been an absolute game changer! This bottle has provided me with hydrated glowing firmer skin without clogging my pores. I have sensitive skin as it is but has amazed me. Instead of wearing makeup I use this everyday in the morning after washing.
Light, non-greasy. Product is not heavy which is a plus in the summertime.

avis.titre: House of Blue is my new go-to!
avis.texte: This blue serum is packed with such moisturizing and skin-plumping ingredients! My skin feels so radiant and hydrated, and still able to breathe! This serum makes my face feel so plump and taut- I feel like my skin is going to experience reverse-aging. Excited to see the continued results once I'm done with the bottle!! I have been getting so many compliments on my skin since I began using it 1. 5 weeks ago. And it felt serendipitous that the compliments came at a museum where I was standing near a huge blue art piece, and at a restaurant that was name Blue sushi :) (See pics)

I have volume loss around my eyes and deep set wrinkles. My skincare routine to combat my eye problems is to use Matrixyl 10% + HA and Argireline Solution 10% from the Ordinary. I tried the Blue Peptide Serum as a replacement and have been pleased with the results. The Blue peptide keeps my eyes just as hydrated. I haven't had it that long to decide whether I will swap from the Ordinary to the Blue peptide but thinking about it.

This product has quickly become a personal favorite. I received it as a trial for a new item and found it to be exceptional. The immediate results were particularly impressive. I intend to integrate this into my regular routine.

I've only been using this serum for about three weeks now, but so far I'm really impressed. I have sensitive, acne-prone, and milia-prone skin, and it hasn't triggered any irritation, breakouts, or milia.This serum leaves my skin looking plump, hydrated, and radiant. The texture is on the thicker side, but it spreads effortlessly and absorbs beautifully without feeling heavy or sticky.My skin has always loved COSRX products, and this new Blue Peptide serum is no exception. It's beautifully formulated, feels luxurious on the skin, and the vibrant blue color makes it stunning to look at. While it's still early, this serum has quickly become a favorite in my routine.
These ingredients have really improved how my skin looks in a short amount of time. I love the plumping effect without being irritating.

I really like the feeling of this. It's thick, but not viscous and glides onto your skin. It's not tacky, either, just absorbs into your skin and leaves a nice, hydrated feeling. I replaced my other dark spot serum with this and the results are actually slightly better than what I was using before. I've been using this for two weeks and I've noticed that my skin looks more even and the smile lines are softer from the pumping effects.

I've been using COSRX The Blue Peptide Serum daily on my face and neck for the past month, and the biggest improvement I've noticed is in my neck. The skin on my neck looks firmer, smoother, and more toned, with less visible sagging than before.I've also seen some improvement in the firmness of my face, especially around my jawline. The serum has a lightweight, comfortable texture that absorbs quickly and feels great on my skin.I have sensitive skin and experienced no irritation, redness, or breakouts during use. My before-and-after photos show the noticeable difference, especially in the appearance of my neck. Overall, I'm very happy with the results and will continue using it.

This is really nice peptide serum. Despite it's blue hue, it goes on transparent and it absorbs quickly. It has no fragrance that I can smell. The texture is pretty standard for a serum. It leaves my face feeling soft, plump, and hydrated. It doesn't leave behind any sticky or tacky feeling like some serums do. I would have to use it more long term to see or comment on the bakuchiol vs traditional retinol use. I don't have sensitive skin but this didn't irritate my skin in any way. I've been looking for a product with peptides to incorporate into my routine and this might end up being it.
I was pleasantly surprised by this serum! It feels silky going on and gives an immediate glow to my skin. This one is definitely going in my daily skincare ritual.

I've only been using this serum for about two weeks, but so far I'm really impressed. I have sensitive, acne-prone, and milia-prone skin, and it hasn't triggered any irritation, breakouts, or milia.This serum leaves my skin looking plump, hydrated, and radiant. The texture is fairly thick, but it spreads effortlessly and absorbs beautifully without feeling heavy or sticky.My skin has always loved COSRX products, and this new Blue Peptide serum is no exception. It's beautifully formulated, feels luxurious on the skin, and the vibrant blue color makes it stunning to look at. While it's still early, this serum has quickly become a favorite in my routine.

An excellent product 100/10! It provides intense hydration and is a star product for sensitive skin an absolute must-have for your routine. It leaves behind an extraordinary glow that is noticeable the moment you apply it!

As someone with acne prone skin, this is the perfect serum to improve skin texture and appearance! I really love how light weight the serum is and how glowy it immediately made my skin! After only a week of use, I have noticed a smoother complexion as well as fading of old acne scarring/marks!
It is very light and fats absorbing. Make my skin feel smooth and moisturizing

I love the new Blue Peptide Serum. First of all I was drawn to the blue color. It looks so inviting. I appreciate the serum doesn't have a scent. The serum is not watery, it is thicker but not too thick. It absorbs well in to the skin. I like to use a new product for at least a month to determine if I see results. Initially after using the serum, my skin feels hydrated and smooth. It even gives my skin a nice glow. It has some of my favorite ingredients. Copper Peptide, hyaluronic acid, Niacinamide. I am 48 and love how my skin feels and looks after using this serum!

I've been using this serum twice a day for the past two weeks, and I'm really enjoying it so far. As someone with sensitive skin, I appreciate that it hasn't caused any irritation or breakouts. The formula is lightweight, absorbs beautifully, and glides on so smoothly.I've already noticed my skin looking a little brighter and feeling firmer (I'm 45 so this is a concern for me), and I'm excited to see the full results after 30 days!

Honest Review: A huge COSRX fan here. For this 2 week trial, the Blue Peptide was used in place of the Vitamin C23 serum in my daily routine. Nightly routine: Cleanse, tone, 6 peptide serum booster, BLUE Peptide, snail mucin, moisture. Morning routine: Micellar water cleanse, alternate between BHA and AHA liquid powder, 6 peptide serum booster, BLUE peptide, SPF 30 moisturizer. Skin became softer and less oily than normal. Overall skin tone became lighter where the dark spots became more noticeable. Will continue to use the BLUE peptide until the whole bottle is finished, I use 1. 5 bulb full fills for face and neck for each application. This bottle will last well over a month or 2. If an update is allowed for future posts, will be able to provide pictures from day 0 to end of bottle cycle.

THIS is my new favorite serum! It has a great consistency and texture - not too thick and not too thin. It goes on smoothly and absorbs into the skin well, leaving my skin hydrated and smoother. It has reduced fine wrinkles, making my skin look more youthful and radiant. It doesn't have a scent either. My daughter has sensitive skin but this serum has been gentle enough for her to use. She's young so she has a lot of acne but since using this serum, her acne has reduced 50%!!

This is a lightweight serum that absorbed quickly but left my skin feeling nice and hydrated. The blue color does not stain the skin but makes it a fun serum. The serum did not irritate my skin it was very gentle. My skin os starting to look very nourished and glassy.

Holy plump-ness! I've been using this for two weeks and shower at night. When I wake up in the morning, I can still feel how plump this serum makes my face. Definitely switching over to using this in the morning to keep the glow, hydration, and plump look for the day. Absolute MUST buy :heart_eyes:I had no negative reactions by adding this to my skin care routine - usually my skin is sensitive to change.Love that it has niacinamide and hyaluronic acid in the ingredients as well.

This formula is amazing! It is the perfect thickness and gives my skin a bouncy glow i haven't seen in a while. I do recommend this at night because it's a greasy look, in my opinion. It takes a while to really set in.

avis.titre: glassy, milky, plush little cloud skin :cloud:
avis.texte: Okay this new blue :sparkles:PEPTIDE:sparkles: serum??? :sob::blue_heart: absolutely unreal. I'm on tretinoin + spironolactone so my skin can get dry FAST, using products that actually support my skin barrier is super important to me. This serum deserves a standing ovation honestly. It is now a staple product for me. I have combination skin, but with all of my acne medications my skin is severely dry. Cosrx is my hero during this time. I'm already obsessed with the snail line, but after adding this serum into my AM/PM routine??OMG. Total game changer. The texture is PERFECT. It's not greasy, heavy, or sticky at all. My skin just drinks it up instantly :sob::blue_heart: it feels like pure plumping hydration and leaves my face looking juicy, smooth, and fresh instead of coated or oily.Like genuinely glassy, milky, plush little cloud skin :cloud:I've been using this product for 2 weeks now. The glow is insane. The plumpness is insane. My skin texture looks smoother, makeup sits prettier, and that tight dry feeling from tret is basically gone. My skin just looks healthy now. Calm, juicy, luminous??like it finally drank water after wandering the desert for 3 business days :sob::blue_heart:

I have been using COSRX products before they became a social media must starting with Snail Mucin and the new Blue Peptide serum is taking everything up a notch!!LOVE, LOVE, LOVEIt has really helped the texture of my skin and reduced the minor age spots that have magically appeared over time. I am constantly asked what I use and will definitely keep adding the Blue Peptide to my daily routine <3
Can't wait to try this. My skin has been riddled with dark spots from my acne so excited to add this to my skincare routine.
I got this as a trial and I am in love. This stuff is amazing and makes my skin look smooth and silky.

I have sensitive, acne-prone oily skin and when I say this serum is out of this world, trust me, it is. My skin feels moisturized and firm after almost 2 weeks of use. The color of the serum is very stable and hasn't changed at all.Get this serum, it has amazing benefits, even for sensitive skin.

I have enjoyed using this serum. It is a bit thicker than the other COSRX serums I have used. It feels comfortable on the skin and does not cause any irritation (I have sensitive skin and easily react to actives). I use it at night instead of retinol and it has been doing a nice job. My skin feels hydrated and nourished. It sinks into the skin quickly and layers well with creams and oils. I would definitely recommend it.

The COSRX peptide is great and makes me feel really glowy! I've been using it for a few days and i love the composition of the serum, it is very light feeling and I really like it so far. Shipping was reliable as well with a tracking number :)
Fantastic plumping serum that really helps with my uneven skin tone and the appearance of my icepick acne scars. Will definitely be wanting more!

I was sent this serum to try, and I really like it so far! I've only tried it for about a week, and to see real skincare results you need to use a product for a few months. The serum is tinted blue, and when you apply it there is a bluish hue, but it doesn't stay. It feels really nice when you apply it to your skin, and I feel like it is helping my dark spots. I use it in conjunction with other COSRX products. I like that you can use it daily and in the morning and at night, whereas a retinol you can only use at night. I'm excited to see how my skin improves over the next few months, and it's nice the serum is a pretty color!

I received this as a free trial and had moderate expectations, but have been using it every night for several nights and wake up with smooth, refreshed skin. I have middle aged skin, and this makes it look younger! I love the color and feel of the serum as well. It's a keeper!!

I quickly purchased another bottle just incase it disappears. This serum keeps my face silky smooth.My face is blemish free and even skin tone is no longer a concern.I wear it during the days and at night- it has been only a week but I can spot the difference already!This is the real deal.

I'm really loving the texture of this serum. It feels lightweight, smooth and sinks into my skin so nicely without feeling sticky. My skin feels hydrated and gives that healthy glowy look after applying it. Also I noticed it literally has no scent, which I personally really like. And I love the soft blue color of it :droplet:One of those products that just feels really nice to use and makes me want to keep reaching for :u1FA75:.:::

I love the blue peptide. My skin looks supple and youthful. The blue peptide along with the cosrx face wash and other beauty regimen products are reversing my aging. The Korean skin care products are clean and truly have made a difference in my skin tone. A forever customer.

avis.titre: The serum I didn't know I needed
avis.texte: Wow, this serum has my skin glowing, my texture evened out and overall spottiness of my complexion smoothed. My skin loves niacinamide so it's a bonus that it has this in. I received this as a promo but will definitely be purchasing and keeping as a staple in my routine.

Love this serum! Feels like a second skin and goes on like silk. I've only been using it for three weeks and already see lightning of areas of dark pigmentation- so much so that I had a BBL scheduled and have decided to cancel it.

I have been using this for about a week now, and I do like it. It makes my skin feel supple and clean. It is also soothing going on. One thing I've noticed as I've aged is how dry my skin gets, which is why I wanted to try the Blue Peptide Serum.

I've only used this for a short time but I already really like it! The texture feels super smooth and hydrating without being greasy, no weird smell, and it gives my skin that glassy glow. I pair it with my other COSRX products like my collagen eye patches and ceramide lip butter mask and it fits perfectly into my nighttime routine. The color is also so pretty, I'm definitely excited to keep using it!

avis.titre: Best plumping and smoothening serum that works overnight!
avis.texte: The blue bottle is power packed with amazing clean ingredients that actually work. I have tried other brand but none showed such quick results.The first night I used, I woke up with plump face, smooth texture and it did not cause any irritation to my cystic acne, instead calmed it down.There is a glass like texture that radiates from the skin.The serum spreads evenly. It's not overly sticky nor oily but my extremely oily skin absorbs it pretty good.The dropper is convenient and the bottle has a seal that even if it falls by mistake, the serum doesn't fall it, saving your money. Phew! It's an amazing design.I would definitely buy it again and it has become regular part of my routine. As an oily skin girly with cystic acne and new emerging fine lines, this gave me glass skin that's pump and glowy.

Loved the scent, very luxurious. It applies well, I used it in the morning before my sunscreen. If you are having an indoor day it leaves a beautiful glow on the skin. The bottle itself is breathtaking. It is the shining center piece of my display shelf. Overall highly recommend.
This is my second review my skin is loving this serum. It does not leave a sticky texture nor has a strong scent. My skin looks healthy and hydrated.

I was initially a little hesitant to try the Blue Peptide Bakuchiol Plump Glow Serum because I had a bad experience with retinol in the past and my skin really didn't react well to it. I've been using this serum daily for about two weeks now, and I'm honestly really impressed with how well it's been working. My skin looks more even overall, and I've already noticed a visible improvement in some of the dark spots left behind from acne.
I love the texture and the benefits of using this serum. Absorbs well and it leaves my skin moisturized and soft.

This blue peptide was not what I expected. It's not creamy, more of a sticky texture BUT not sticky on your skin. It blends easily and instantly makes my face feel smooth. The next morning, my skin is so soft! I love it. And, I love that it comes in a glass bottle instead of a plastic one! Thank you:)

I love this product! Didn't think I would love it, but it's hydrating and makes my face feel plump. Super easy to use and doesn't feel sticky. The scent isn't bad at all and is nice. I have super sensitive skin and I have no reaction to it. I have been using it day and night everyday and love it so far! The color is a pretty blue. Overall my skin has looked better and feels better since using it.

Added to my night routine, in addition to my retinol 0. 5 oil, snail radiance dual essence, and moisturizer. My skin feels and looks moisturized un the morning and a reduction of discoloration from the occasional breakout. It helps my skintone to be much more of an even color and glowy!

The CISRX Blue Peptide Bakuchiol serum is amazing. It's fragrance free light watery, silky, smooth absorbs quickly into the skin with no tackiness or stickiness. My skin feels hydrated nourished and it looks plump healthy with glassy like glow.
I've only been using is for 2 weeks but so far I see that it makes my skin look and feel soft.

So far I've been loving it! I've been using it for a little over 2 weeks, and I've already started to notice a small difference in my pores. I'm a huge fan of the COSRX 6 Peptide Skin Booster and have used it for over 2 years now, but so far I think I'm liking this one even more!It makes my skin feel moisturized without feeling heavy at all. I've used it both at night and as skin prep before makeup, and for me it has worked wonders! I also love that it's fragrance-free, which is perfect for my sensitive skin. And the service was great too!

It's really working amazing. Blue peptide serum helps my skin repair, my skin feels fresh and glowy. Colour of the serum is unexpected, this is the first time I saw serum in blue and its texture is very soothing. Its been 4 years I started using cosrx products and this is my forever favorite brand. Thank you cosrx for this beautiful gift. :hibiscus:

This new serum is AMAZING! The vibrant blue color is gorgeous, and it goes on so smooth and easy! It is very hydrating and light-weight. After just one use, I noticed a reduction in my usual redness, that comes from my sensitive skin. Having been using the serum for a week, now, I can say my redness has continued to reduce, my skin feels firmer, my pores look great, and I continue to get compliments on how much of a healthy glow I have. I definitely recommend adding this to your routine!

I am so happy I received this from cosrx. The formula feels so nice. I have been applying a small amount evenly and starting to notice how much firmer and smoother my skin is feeling . My skin definitely has a glow and I can't wait to see it reduce the appearance of dark spots

A must buy! I was waiting a week to see results to write a review. I use niacinamide and hyaluronic acid serum however this peptide has both plus more. My skin glows after each use. I cannot tell you how many compliments I get. I am extremely happy with the results I am adding to my skincare routine.

This serum seems to be doing what it says-my fine lines and uneven texture seems to be smoothing out. Shared with my Granny friends and they're hooked too! With quality products you don't need a cupboard full of products!
This one is really good and provides lots of shine and softness

My skin is too sensitive for retinol, so I was so happy to learn about bakuchiol!!It's not irritating at all, which is rare for my skin. It's only been a week since I started using, but I think my skin looks more glowy already!

avis.titre: So far my skin is liking it
avis.texte: I thought this was such an interesting product and I'm glad I have had the opportunity to try it out. I have seen small improvement in my skin texture but also it just feels nice on the skin. I can't wait to see the results overtime and the benefits of using Bakuchiol

This Cosrx Blue Peptide Serum is wonderful to use on aging skin. I love the texture and the benefits of using this serum daily into my skin care routine. Once applied it leaves your skin so moisturized and it's improving the way my skin looks!! I LOVE IT!!!

First off the bottle is HUGE! This will last you a long time. I love Bakiuchiol as a retinol alternative because I have sensitive skin, and this just felt so soothing to my skin and caused no irritation. I use this in the AM once to twice a week, and it doesn't feel too heavy or look too glossy or glowy for the day. Make sure to use SPF after!

I've been using the COSRX The Blue Peptide Bakuchiol Plump Glow Serum for a little while now and I'm genuinely impressed with how hydrating and smoothing it feels on my skin. The texture is lightweight and silky, absorbs quickly, and layers really well under moisturizer and makeup without feeling sticky.After consistent use, my skin looked more plump, glowy, and refreshed ??especially in the morning. I also love that it combines copper peptides and bakuchiol, so it gives anti-aging benefits without being harsh or irritating. My skin can be sensitive at times, and this serum felt calming and nourishing rather than heavy.The packaging is sleek, the formula feels high-end, and a little goes a long way. Overall, this is a great option if you're looking for a serum that boosts hydration, glow, and skin softness while supporting smoother-looking skin over time. Definitely a product I'll keep in my skincare routine!

I've been using COSRX The Blue Peptide Bakuchiol Plump Glow Serum as part of my regular daily skincare routine and I love it! It has a silky texture and absorbs easily. It feels very hydrating and gives my skin a noticeable glow. My skin looks plumper and it has improved the appearance of pores. It has also started to soften some of my fine lines and I'm excited to see even more results with continued use. I also love the beautiful blue color!

I've been using the Blue Peptide Bakuchiol Plump Serum for a week, and I'm honestly impressed with how hydrated and smooth my skin looks. The texture is lightweight and silky, absorbs quickly, and gives a healthy glow without feeling greasy. My skin feels noticeably plumper in the morning, and I love that it layers well under moisturizer and makeup. Hoping the bakuchiol will help smooth some of crows feet with continued use. Definitely a new favorite in my skincare routine!
This serum is light and actually smells good. It's a little too soon for me to notice a huge difference, but I love anything by COSRX!

avis.titre: Really nice on my very sensitive skin
avis.texte: I have only been using this product 2x a day for 3 days now. So far i am really liking the way my skin feels + looks. I haven't had any bad reactions either, which is pretty common + almost immediate with many things i try. It goes on smooth, gives a nice shine + hydration + also helps my makeup go on nicely. So far so good! Thanks cosrx for another AWESOME product!

Bakuchiol is the star ingredient of this serum and it's perfect for those where a tretinoin was too harsh. It feel luxurious to apply, sinks in well while leaving a nice, plump glow. I used it in the morning and my sunscreen and makeup applied over it easily.

I have been using this serum for about a week now. It is not as watery as some of the other COSRX serums. It is very comfortable on the skin and sinks in nicely. I have very sensitive skin and did not get any irritation from it. It feels hydrating and leaves my skin supple. I usually put it on over night. It is too early for me to tell whether there have been any significant changes in my skin, but, so far, I really am enjoying this serum. I would recommend it, especially yo folks with sensitive skin who are looking for a retinol alternative.
i like the gel texture and fragrance free. my skin stays hydrated over night and skin feels smooth in the morning. not too sure about the blue color :sweat_smile:

I received a full size of the product to give my opinion. I love the color. I like how this makes my face look like it is glowing and is smoother. I took a picture and there are no filters. I do have acne and dark spots. In my few days of using it, the acne is still there but it looks better than when I first started using it. I'm going to order more!

I am a 47 year old mom of 3. I have used many ghkcu products. I love all things skin care. First, the bottle is big! Like most cosrx products, they are generous and won't only last a month. It smells fresh and is nice and thick. It goes on smoothly and spreads great. It definitely leaves a dewy look. This is only my 3rd day using it so I can't comment of effectiveness but I am a consistent skin care girl, so will definitely update after 30 days and then again when I finish the bottle.
Love this! My skin has literally improved overnight, it looks so glowy!
Absolutely love this product! My face look amazing. Highly recommended
